newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-RIOS $13.5 MILLION TRANSFER SETS SPANISH RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RIOS $13.5 MILLION TRANSFER SETS SPANISH RECORD.

text.p: Athletic Bilbao have paid two billion pesetas ($13.5 million) for Spanish international defender Roberto Rios, Spanish newspapers reported on Sunday.
The transfer is the biggest ever involving a Spanish player.
Rios, 26, had played for Real Betis since 1992.
He has seven caps to his name, having played in all of Spain's matches since he made his international debut against the Czech Republic last October.
Rios, the son of former Spanish international Eusebio Rios, was a target for Manchester United earlier in the year, but a reported offer of $10.5 million was turned down.
